summary: The marketing team is pivoting to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs with a new SEO-driven strategy, while simultaneously redesigning the knowledge website and managing urgent IT fixes that are blocking productivity.
summaryDetail: The immediate focus is on the SEO and content strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting target areas and the team analyzing participant profiles to capture search demand in AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing. Concurrently, the knowledge website redesign is in review, with decisions to remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topic sections, and Joseph is incorporating feedback to enhance the homepage layout. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook authentication issues across all devices to restore email functionality, which is critical for communication. Upcoming: finalize the website redesign, execute the SEO plan, and prepare for the Bayes Business School meeting on Sept 11, while also advancing the new book promotion and brand video follow-ups.

meetings.title: IT Troubleshooting and Meeting Summary

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the proposed knowledge website redesign, noting that while the menu categorization improved, the overall layout remains similar to the current site. They discussed incorporating elements from Joseph's alternative design to display more articles and bring indices to the homepage.

meetings.title: Marketing Strategy for China Programs
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing, with a focus on SEO and content optimization to capture search demand for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing in China.
